is a candy wonderland which is quite evident as the ground is light red and the hills were pink. A massive light red baseplate surrounds the map. Hills surrounds the path, but the terrain was rather flat. The trees around the map mostly have white bark and pink leaves. There is also a chocolate river running through the middle of the map, with a simple wooden bridge spanning it. The river blockades any towers being placed on that part of the map. Lollipops and chocolate bars are found around the map.
The brown path began and ends at two candy caves. The path is dead straight, with no turns and is very short.
